en_title: Cyberpunk 2077 Gets Surprise Official New Update Announcement From CD Projekt
subtitle: 重返夜之城
opus_summary: 《赛博朋克2077》2.5免费更新将于10月22日推出，加入义体自定义与双持玩法。更新包含受《赛博朋克：边缘行者2》启发的内容，Switch 2版将稍后上线。

paragraphs.en: CD Projekt has announced a surprise update to Cyberpunk 2077, due out this week.
paragraphs.cn: CD Projekt意外宣布，《赛博朋克2077》将于本周推出更新。

paragraphs.en: The Cyberpunk 2077 Edgerunners 2 Update (2.5) launches Thursday, October 22, and while CD Projekt kept the details quiet, it has confirmed it will feature content "inspired" by the anime. Edgerunners 2 hits Netflix today, so this update is well-timed to capitalize on heightened interest in all things Cyberpunk 2077.
paragraphs.cn: 《赛博朋克2077》「边缘行者2」更新（2.5版）将于10月22日星期四上线。虽然CD Projekt尚未透露具体细节，但已确认更新将包含受这部动画「启发」的内容。《赛博朋克：边缘行者2》今天登陆Netflix，此次更新恰好可以借势，吸引因动画而更加关注《赛博朋克2077》相关内容的观众。

paragraphs.en: But what, exactly, is in the update itself? CD Projekt took to social media to confirm that Cyberpunk 2077 will get "new items and features," which includes the content inspired by Edgerunners 2."
paragraphs.cn: 但这次更新究竟有哪些内容？CD Projekt在社交媒体上确认，《赛博朋克2077》将加入「新物品和新功能」，其中包括受《赛博朋克：边缘行者2》启发的内容。

paragraphs.en: "Update 2.5 will be dropping on October 22, 2026, marking yet another opportunity to dive back into Night City or experience it for the very first time," the developer continued.
paragraphs.cn: 开发商接着表示：「2.5更新将于2026年10月22日推出，玩家又有机会重返夜之城，或是首次体验这座城市。」

paragraphs.en: What does new "features" mean? In yet another social media post , this time from the Cyberpunk 2077 account, CD Projekt teased, "New Edgerunners, new chrome, new playstyle," adding: "We're talking cyberware customization, a new dual-wielding playstyle, and more!"
paragraphs.cn: 新的「功能」指的是什么？CD Projekt又通过《赛博朋克2077》账号发布了一条社交媒体帖子，预告称：「新的边缘行者、新的义体、新的玩法。」帖子还补充道：「我们说的是义体自定义、全新的双持玩法，还有更多内容！」

paragraphs.en: The mention of a new dual-wielding playstyle has certainly got fans excited. “So f***ing hyped about what we cooked for you,” teased Paweł Sasko , associate game director on the in-development Cyberpunk 2. Perhaps fans should get their hopes up, then.
paragraphs.cn: 全新双持玩法的消息确实让粉丝们兴奋不已。正在开发中的《赛博朋克2》副游戏总监Paweł Sasko也卖起了关子：「想到我们给你们准备的东西，我他妈就兴奋得不行。」看来，粉丝们或许确实可以期待一下。

paragraphs.en: More details about the Edgerunners 2 Update will be revealed on October 21, 2026, during a special episode of REDstreams, CD Projekt said. Patch notes are scheduled for publication on the same day. The free update itself launches across PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X and S, with the Nintendo Switch 2 release to "follow shortly."
paragraphs.cn: CD Projekt表示，将于2026年10月21日在REDstreams特别节目中公布此次《赛博朋克：边缘行者2》更新的更多详情，补丁说明也计划于同日发布。此次免费更新将登陆PC、PS5和XBOX Series，Switch 2版将「很快跟进」。

paragraphs.en: Cyberpunk 2077 fans have been calling on CD Projekt to release meaningful DLC for some time now . Some even hold out hope for an expansion for the near six-year-old game, especially in light of the announcement of the Songs of the Past expansion for the 11-year-old The Witcher 3.
paragraphs.cn: 《赛博朋克2077》的粉丝呼吁CD Projekt推出有实质内容的DLC，已经有一段时间了。有些人甚至仍盼着这款发售近6年的游戏能推出资料片，尤其是看到发售已有11年的《巫师3》公布了《旧时曲》资料片之后。

paragraphs.en: In May, CD Projekt insisted it had “no plans” for further Cyberpunk 2077 DLCs or expansions , disappointing fans. The comment suggested that fans would have to wait for Cyberpunk 2 for more from CD Projekt’s much-loved dystopian universe. And the wait looks like it's going to be significant; Cyberpunk 2 is further behind The Witcher 4, and CD Projekt co-CEO Michał Nowakowski has suggested Cyberpunk 2 won’t be out until at least 2030.
paragraphs.cn: 今年5月，CD Projekt坚称「没有计划」为《赛博朋克2077》推出更多DLC或资料片，让粉丝们颇为失望。这番表态暗示，粉丝若想体验CD Projekt笔下这个备受喜爱的反乌托邦世界的更多内容，就得等到《赛博朋克2》了。而这一等看来会相当漫长：《赛博朋克2》的开发进度比《巫师4》更靠后，CD Projekt联席首席执行官Michał Nowakowski也曾暗示，《赛博朋克2》最早也要到2030年才会发售。

paragraphs.en: But this news of a 2.5 update for Cyberpunk 2077 runs counter somewhat to CD Projekt's statement in May, and has already got fans either dusting off their download, or redownloading the game in anticipation of what's to come.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，《赛博朋克2077》将推出2.5更新的消息，与CD Projekt在5月的声明有些出入。粉丝们已经开始重新打开搁置已久的游戏，或是重新下载游戏，期待接下来的新内容。

paragraphs.en: In July, CD Projekt confirmed that Cyberpunk 2077 had sold an incredible 40 million copies since its December 2020 launch, up 5 million from November 2025. It's received one expansion so far, 2023's Phantom Liberty starring Idris Elba.
paragraphs.cn: CD Projekt在7月确认，《赛博朋克2077》自2020年12月发售以来，销量已达惊人的4,000万份，比2025年11月增加了500万份。该作至今推出了一部资料片，即2023年由伊德里斯·艾尔巴出演的《往日之影》。

paragraphs.en: While you wait to find out what's in this new Cyberpunk 2077 update, check out IGN's review of Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 .
paragraphs.cn: 在等待了解《赛博朋克2077》这次更新的具体内容时，不妨先看看IGN对《赛博朋克：边缘行者2》的评测。
